upload.title: Snowed In for 5 Days: Would You Survive? (3 Choices)
upload.description:
A blizzard cuts off your village. The power is out, firewood is running low, and the only help is a neighbor who never opens his door. Make three choices — would you survive?

Survival tips in this story are general information, not professional advice.
